name: nightly
prompt: This is the nightly regression report from `bun run nightly` in the Harness repo: bun tests, typecheck, swift test, the Mac app checks and the full iPhone walkthrough. A green run prints nothing, so any output here means something failed (or a layer was skipped). Decline it if it only says all green or lists no failing layer. If a layer failed, dispatch it to an agent in the HARNESS project: name the failing layer(s) and check(s), include the rerun command and the log tail from the report, and ask the agent to find the regression (git log since the last green run helps), fix it with a test, and run `bun run verify`. If a ticket already covers the same failing layer and checks, send it there as a message instead of creating a new one. If the only problem is a simulator layer skipped for low disk, decline and say so, since that needs the human to free space.
